Yesteryear Became a Cultural Sensation. Caro Claire Burke Is Still Reeling

The nurses in the labor and delivery unit at a Boston-area hospital were in for a surprise. On the Wednesday in September when their book club was scheduled to discuss Caro Claire Burke ’s Yesteryear , the author herself showed up to deliver her first child. Which is how, in the heady aftermath of giving birth, Burke found herself propped up in her hospital bed, signing copies of her novel.
